mechanism: The helper is `define hidden` (external: its callers are reachable program items), so IPSCCP cannot fold the callers' 0 into it, and DeadArgumentElimination's removeDeadArgumentsFromCallers rewrites any argument the body never uses to poison at every direct call site (callers then lose the original mov r2,0 and its reuse for a None spill). The original therefore needs a no-code IR use of the size at DAE time. rustc's MIR builder lowers `enum as int` to discriminant + assume(discr <= max) when the tag's valid range is restricted; for a single value 0 that is `icmp eq i64 %0, 0` + llvm.assume, the same use the unsafe hint gave. DAE keeps the argument (call sites pass i64 noundef 0) and GVN folds the cast to minimum_balance(.., 0), so the body keeps mov64 r2,0x0.
